searchText: do they have instant transactions like LN? thats def an issue for rollups i think. If you have to wait for a batch before a transaction is good. sometimes there are 15 minutes between batches yeah transactions aren't something that you sign and then exists on chain, it's a cooperative process: the destination give the sender an h = H(R) and when the sender learns the R they know the payment has been received and that all can happen in well under a second, less with fewer hops See https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4444 I mean I feel like this should only be done in conjunction with a regenesis What do you mean by regenesis? This is one of many forms of it. the kind where you have to recover frozen states from before the regenesis checkpoint by posting a merkle proof This proposal is only for block header/body/receipt history pruning, not for state expiry. Full current state would still be retained by all full nodes. It seems like a change in the network dynamics to keep the state around but not keep the history to get there
